title: Deprecated plug-in function call
description: Maintenance rule — plug-in function calls whose documentation marks the function as deprecated (verbatim status from the MBS docs mirror via reference/plugin_spec.duckdb). Deprecated functions still run today, but they are modernization debt: the vendor documents a successor for most of them, carried per row in the 'replacement' column. Includes one-level custom-function wrappers (via_custom_function) and layout/field calculation usages (evidence_kind='layout'). Functions of a known plugin without a doc entry appear as explicit 'unresolved' info rows (only in this rule, not in the removed sibling — one surface per set). This is the maintenance axis, not the platform axis: a deprecated finding says nothing about runtime environments.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Deprecated plug-in functions keep working for now, but they stop receiving fixes and can be removed in a future plugin release. The status is a verbatim vendor statement from the documentation mirror.
rule.remediation: Replace the call with the documented successor; each finding row carries it in the 'replacement' column (empty when the vendor documents no replacement). Unresolved functions: update the MBS docs mirror (install-mbs-docs) and re-derive the plugin map.
